text: Brent settled at 91.80 USD/bbl on 24 November, up 0.7% from the previous close, and is down 1.2% over the past week and 28.4% over the past month. The most recent Egypt update, dated 1 November, is that the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds was extended to 14 Dec 2026. Separately, Genel Energy agreed on 28 September to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
